verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server and agent Skills that let users drive web, local, image, video and news search plus summarization through natural-language requests in Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code and similar agent hosts. Its Answers endpoint also takes natural-language questions through the OpenAI SDK and returns grounded answers. The natural-language parsing itself comes from the host LLM, and the free-tier ToS reportedly bars AI inference, so a separate AI plan is needed. missing for 10: natural-language control of non-search operations such as configuring Goggles, filters or account and API-key management, and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven use.
